integrity: Analytic proof includes every integer n>=3, m>=2, all rotations and repeated phases. Finite polygon and circular-sampling diagnostics supplement, but do not certify, the analytic proof or mathematical originality.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes finitely many congruent regular polygons with exactly coincident centers; translations, nonregular polygons, mixed sizes, and higher-dimensional unions are excluded. Radial-weight rigidity requires a nonnegative density positive almost everywhere on the annulus between apothem and circumradius.
title: Universal radial coverage by concentric regular-polygon unions
